To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a simulation approach is presented, that allows to handle the ESD simulation and the analysis on a chip complexity.
the presented simulation tool allows to analyze ESD paths on a chip level.
the presented ESD analysis concept allows to perform a worst case analysis of a mixed signal design with high abstraction levels and a high degree of automation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a simulation approach for worst case ESD path analysis on chip level.
the development and evaluation of new methods for the analysis of ESD paths.
the development of a high level ESD simulation approach for complex designs and a framework that supports the ESD analysis process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ESD simulation and ESD analysis on a system level is feasible, and that the simulation results are in line with the expectations from a conventional ESD analysis.
the proposed simulation approach is a valuable tool in the ESD design process.
the proposed simulation approach allows a high abstraction level analysis of complex designs with respect to ESD protection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a simulation tool that allows the analysis of the worst case ESD protection of an IC.
the presented simulation approach allows a very efficient and fast ESD analysis of complex mixed signal designs with a high degree of abstraction.
the presented simulation approach allows to identify ESD paths in the chip level complexity and to analyze their impact on ESD protection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a permutational EDS simulation approach is feasible and allows a fast and accurate ESD simulation of complex designs with a high abstraction level.
the proposed simulation method is able to identify the most critical paths in a complex design, and to identify the worst-case ESD protection circuit configuration.
the proposed approach allows to identify the most critical ESD paths in complex SoCs and to provide a fail reporting interface to the ESD design flow.
